propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations independently, each re-deciding basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and environment setup, causing duplication and maintenance burden.

Three sites lack --basetemp: bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py (executes real integration nodes), git_version_floor.py (collect-only child), and live_jira_xdist_confinement.py (collect-only child), reproducing a defect from three closed bugs.

A centralized run_nested_pytest() helper must accept required env parameter verbatim without merging or modification, to preserve security constraints on repr-safe minimal environment mappings at four call sites.

The helper must preserve timeout as a subprocess.run keyword, return CompletedProcess unmodified by identity, and propagate TimeoutExpired to callers, per the contract pinned by test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py.

Exactly fourteen launch sites under tests/ must be converted; two sites (test_scripts_import_convention.py and test_tests_import_convention.py) must NOT be converted because they deliberately launch the bare pytest console script from outside the repo.

An AST-based uniqueness guard must verify exactly one nested-pytest launch site remains (the helper definition) and no hand-built sys.executable -m pytest literals persist in list/tuple position across the test tree.
